## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant focused tests pass.
- [ ] Full package tests pass at one Julia thread.
- [ ] Threaded tests pass when parallel code changed.
- [ ] Numerical changes preserve objectives, residuals, gaps, and PSD checks.
- [ ] Performance claims include reproducible before/after measurements.

## Compatibility and provenance

- [ ] Public API or behavior changes are documented.
- [ ] New dependencies have compatibility bounds.
- [ ] Third-party code or algorithms are attributed with compatible licenses.
- [ ] AI assistance, if material, is disclosed and the output was reviewed.
